export_evidence: ImportKey (slug 'wirtgen-india-private-limited') shows 93,064 records, 206 trading partners, latest cargo 2026-02-28, but every visible row is INBOUND: "2026-02-28 | HAMM AG. | WIRTGEN INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | DIFFUSER PART NO.1263153 (180 PCS) PARTS FOR ROAD ROLLER | NUREMBERG, GERMANY | SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4, India | 39269099 | BOL 7810008". Top ports are all import lanes (COLOGNE 4783, SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC 3736, NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1 2512). No outbound India-origin record with date/destination/HS/B-L was visible on any free page. Source counter: page claims 93,064 shipments; rows actually seen = 3 (all imports).
note: Company exists and is active: WIRTGEN INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED, 22-B Kumbalgodu Industrial Area, Mysore Road, First Phase (address shown on ImportKey). It is the Indian manufacturing/sales arm of the Wirtgen Group (Wirtgen GmbH, Joseph Vögele, Hamm, Kleemann) and clearly a real operating entity, but the only customs evidence retrievable is import-side: it receives parts from German parent plants. No export shipment record (India origin, with date, destination, HS and B-L) could be confirmed on free views — volza, eximpedia and trademo all returned HTTP 403, and the search backend was down for the whole session, so this is a coverage gap, not proof of absence. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, annual-report India split) not retrieved — null, not public in the pages reached. Declared HS 843149 (parts of machinery of 8426/8429/8430) is plausible for road-construction/earthmoving equipment parts, but the observed import rows carry HS 39269099, 73269099, 85371090 — no HS correction is proposed here since this role covers shipments only. Verdict on shipments: no export trail found; domestic trail not established.
